additional_vitolas.name: Half Corona (Maduro - San Andres)
additional_vitolas.notes: Matches the Mac photo. Wrapper San Andres Maduro, binder/filler Nicaraguan. $4.80/cigar, boxes of 25. 5th regular-production size in the Hot Cake Maduro line, shipped December 2023. FLAG: factory attribution conflicts within the same source article (body text names Fabrica de Tabacos HVC S.A.; the article's own 'Blend and Origin' box names Tabacos Valle de Jalapa S.A./TABSA) - recorded as an open discrepancy, not resolved by guessing.
